chain.text:
# MPS-on candidate: the pinned vllm-omni minicpmo_4_5_turn_mrv2_h200.yaml plus vllm-omni's own private-MPS switch.
base_config: /workspace/cgzheng/cgzheng/vllm-omni/vllm_omni/deploy/minicpmo_4_5_turn_mrv2_h200.yaml
cuda_mps: true

# Opt-in single-H200 throughput profile for turn-mode MiniCPM-o 4.5.
# Use NVIDIA MPS when sharing the GPU across stages. Warm representative
# streaming shapes before admitting traffic: graph capture can delay
# first audio by seconds. Talker capacity 16 reduces C32 admission-tail
# latency at similar throughput; C16 P99 varied across independent starts.
# This reserves 4 GiB of Talker KV (2 GiB more than the generic MRv2 profile).
# Keep room for lazy graph caches on the 141 GiB H200.
#
# FP32 weights/caches are retained, but the opt-in TF32 policy changes
# rounding. Quality evidence and limits:
# docs/design/minicpm_o45_mrv2_performance.md
base_config: minicpmo_4_5_turn_mrv2.yaml

stages:
  - stage_id: 1
    max_num_seqs: 16

platforms:
  cuda:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 1
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 4294967296

# Opt-in CUDA Model Runner V2 profile for MiniCPM-o 4.5 turn serving: the
# Thinker (stage 0), Talker (stage 1) and Code2Wav (stage 2) run on MRv2.
# The Thinker uses native multimodal encoding and tensor-only FULL graphs;
# downstream stages use the native data plane. This profile serves
# turn-based sessions; duplex on MRv2 uses minicpmo_4_5_duplex_mrv2.yaml.
#
# On MRv2 the Talker keeps its sampled codec id, 16-frame penalty history and
# EOS state on the device (no per-step D2H wait), and Code2Wav schedules
# individual chunks instead of holding a slot per utterance, so more than
# max_num_seqs streams can be live under load.
base_config: minicpmo_4_5_turn.yaml

connectors:
  connector_of_shared_memory:
    extra:
      hift_graph_capture_batch_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8]
      # Ordinary TF32 for CFM DiT GEMMs (~25% less GPU time per chunk at
      # batch 1-8): cuBLAS allow_tf32 on dense QKV/MLP and Triton
      # input_precision=tf32 on tiled attention. HiFT stays IEEE FP32.
      # Numerics: HiFT input mel moves by ~3e-4 relative L2; dev-short
      # WER/UTMOS unchanged.
      token2wav_allow_tf32: true

stages:
  - stage_id: 0
    model_runner: v2
    # llm2tts consumes the completed Thinker payload via the orchestrator.
    # Only Talker -> Code2Wav is a streaming connector edge. Keep the latent
    # rows on the full-payload output channel instead of partitioning them
    # into an async connector that this stage does not have.
    async_chunk: false
  - stage_id: 1
    model_runner: v2
    max_num_seqs: 8
  - stage_id: 2
    model_runner: v2
    max_num_seqs: 8
    async_scheduling: false
    env:
      # Decode waiting first chunks in their own step, but only while every
      # stream with a later chunk ready still holds 0.5 s of unplayed audio,
      # so first packets do not come at the cost of playback underruns.
      VLLM_OMNI_CODEC_FIRST_CHUNK_EXPRESS: "1"
      VLLM_OMNI_CODEC_FIRST_CHUNK_EXPRESS_SLACK_S: "0.5"

platforms:
  cuda:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 1
        # Reserve enough KV for eight concurrent 4096-token Talker requests.
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 2147483648
  npu:
    model_runner: v1
  xpu:
    model_runner: v1
  rocm:
    model_runner: v1
  musa:
    model_runner: v1

# MiniCPM-o 4.5 using the turn-based engine and ordinary HTTP serving.
base_config: minicpmo_4_5.yaml
session_mode: turn

# MiniCPM-o 4.5 three-stage deploy on one large-memory GPU.
pipeline: minicpmo_4_5
async_chunk: true
# Use minicpmo_4_5_turn.yaml to select the ordinary turn-based serving engine.
session_mode: duplex
# Keep the active window aligned with the session and stage capacities below.
# A smaller window serializes first-packet generation for concurrent chat turns.
duplex_session:
  # Matches Stage 0/1 max_num_seqs below.
  max_sessions: 16

trust_remote_code: true
enable_prefix_caching: false

connectors:
  connector_of_shared_memory:
    name: SharedMemoryConnector
    extra:
      connector_get_sleep_s: 0.01
      connector_get_max_wait_first_chunk: 3000
      connector_get_max_wait: 300
      codec_chunk_frames: 25
      codec_left_context_frames: 3
      # HiFT capture buckets are derived from codec_chunk_frames and
      # codec_left_context_frames. (#5869)
      # A future initial_codec_chunk_frames shape will use lazy capture unless
      # HiFTGraphWrapper.derive_capture_bucket_size explicitly includes it.
      enable_hift_graph: true
      # Capture batch-1 continuation/tail shapes without padding: with the
      # 8-frame mel cache these codec widths cover 16-64 mel frames.
      hift_graph_continuation_frames: [4, 28]
      hift_graph_exact_batch_sizes: [1]
      enable_cfm_graph: true
      # Exact continuation batches 1..16 share one startup arena; no padding.
      # Uncaptured shapes stay eager without request-time eviction/recapture.
      enable_code2wav_encoder_graph: true
      # An integer selects every batch up to this limit; a list selects exact batches.
      code2wav_encoder_graph_rows: 16
      # Three reachable default-prompt cache lengths per batch. Other lengths stay eager.
      code2wav_encoder_max_graphs: 48
      # Used only when startup precapture installs nothing and capture falls
      # back to the request path. A full cache still stays eager.
      code2wav_encoder_capture_after: 8
      # Whole-Euler CUDA graphs exist for batch 1, 2, 4, ... up to
      # micro_batch_size, which defaults to Stage 2 max_num_seqs: all graphs
      # share one attention-cache arena of that many requests (~0.6 GiB each
      # in fp32, 10 GiB at 16). Larger batches replay micro-batches;
      # B > max_graph_batch runs eager.
      max_graph_batch: 16
      cfm_max_graphs: 32

stages:
  - stage_id: 0
    max_num_seqs: 16
    # Leave headroom on the shared GPU for Talker KV + concurrent Code2Wav.
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.55
    enforce_eager: false
    tensor_parallel_size: 1
    max_num_batched_tokens: 16384
    devices: "0"
    # Required for MiniCPM interleaved image/audio Daily-Omni packs (~78% recipe).
    # Keep these in YAML so they are applied through --deploy-config.
    interleave_mm_strings: true
    media_io_kwargs:
      video:
        fps: 1
        num_frames: 128
    limit_mm_per_prompt:
      # Daily-Omni: up to 64 interleaved image/audio pairs (1fps).
      image: 64
      audio: 64
      video: 1
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.0
      top_p: 1.0
      top_k: -1
      max_tokens: 2048
      seed: 42
      detokenize: true
      # 1.0 for MCQ accuracy; 1.1 can bias short A–D answers.
      repetition_penalty: 1.0

  - stage_id: 1
    max_num_seqs: 16
    # Preserve the checkpoint's full-attention Talker prompt while it fits;
    # native duplex rolls over to a one-chunk window at context capacity.
    # Leave device-level headroom for the colocated HiFi-GAN cuDNN workspace.
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.15
    enforce_eager: false
    max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
    # Talker context is 4096 (tts_config.max_position_embeddings).
    max_model_len: 4096
    devices: "0"
    output_connectors:
      to_stage_2: connector_of_shared_memory
    # Talker is a single-vocab codec LM. These knobs go to vLLM's Sampler
    # (head_code logits). EOS is tts_config.eos_token_id (num_audio_tokens-1).
    # Values track upstream utils.TTSSamplingParams (min_p/win_size/tau_r are
    # declared there but never read, so they stay out). repetition_penalty is
    # consumed by the Talker, which rescores it over upstream's 16-frame window
    # instead of the Sampler's whole-stream presence penalty.
    # min_tokens is upstream's min_new_token.
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.8
      top_p: 0.85
      top_k: 25
      repetition_penalty: 1.05
      min_tokens: 50
      max_tokens: 4096
      seed: 42
      detokenize: false

  - stage_id: 2
    max_num_seqs: 16
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.18
    enforce_eager: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    max_num_batched_tokens: 65536
    max_model_len: 65536
    devices: "0"
    input_connectors:
      from_stage_1: connector_of_shared_memory
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.0
      top_p: 1.0
      top_k: -1
      max_tokens: 65536
      detokenize: true

platforms:
  cuda:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 1
        # Full-attention occupancy is bounded by max_num_seqs * max_model_len
        # (16 * 4096 = 65536 tokens). Keep the reported CUDA KV token capacity
        # above that bound because physical-preemption replay is unsupported
        # (2 GiB holds ~35k tokens). The explicit cap leaves device headroom
        # for concurrent Stage 2.
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 4294967296  # 4 GiB

  npu:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        # 32768 leaves no KV cache on 910B1 at gpu_memory_utilization 0.55.
        # Audio Conv1d stays eager; the transformer stack is what this graph replays.
        additional_config:
          encoder_enable_npu_graph: true
          encoder_max_npu_graphs: 4  # Per encoder (vision/audio).
        max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
        compilation_config:
          cudagraph_mode: PIECEWISE
      - stage_id: 1
        # Match CUDA's fixed KV budget and leave headroom for Stage 2.
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 4294967296  # 4 GiB
        max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
        compilation_config:
          cudagraph_mode: PIECEWISE
      - stage_id: 2
        # Stage 2 stays outer-eager; CFM Whole-Euler, HiFT and encoder
        # graphs use the shared Code2Wav wrappers with NPUGraph.
        additional_config:
          code2wav_enable_npu_graph: true
          code2wav_max_npu_graphs: 32
